observed.ui_failure: Local memory timed out after 60 minutes

interpretation: The worker was still computing rather than hung, but the UI stopped waiting and exposed no count or resumable checkpoint. The owner stopped the run.
privacy: No conversation text, local path, process ID or identifier is published.
decision: Reject Checkpoint 7C. Save vectors in small committed batches, show real counts, remove the fixed connection timeout and permit returning to chat while indexing.
